item.title: DynoSim: Simulating the Pareto Frontier
item.description: I worked on DynoSim and coauthored the NVIDIA technical blog introducing it. DynoSim is a workload-driven discrete-event simulation of the NVIDIA Dynamo serving stack: a digital twin that combines engine timing, scheduler behavior, routing, planning, KV-cache effects, and workload traces on one virtual timeline.
